fragrances.name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A rounder, warmer take on Sauvage: bergamot and Sichuan pepper open onto lavender, star anise and nutmeg, then settle into ambroxan softened by a touch of vanilla. Still bright and assertive, but smoother and slightly sweeter than the original.
pros: Smoother and warmer than the original

fragrances.name: Bleu de Chanel Parfum
fragrances.description: A deeper, creamier reading of Bleu de Chanel in which the citrus-aromatic opening quickly gives way to smooth sandalwood and cedar. Polished and restrained, it wears closer to the skin and woodier than the Eau de Parfum.
pros: Easy to wear in professional settings
Holds up from morning to evening
cons: Costs more than the other Bleu versions

fragrances.name: Y Le Parfum
fragrances.description: Takes the apple-and-sage profile of Y into darker territory, with aldehydes, ginger and grapefruit up top and lavender, geranium and a tonka-patchouli base underneath. Denser and more evening-leaning than the Eau de Parfum.
pros: Darker, more nocturnal take on Y
Distinct from the EDP despite shared DNA

fragrances.name: Stronger With You Intensely
fragrances.description: A dense, sweet amber in which pink pepper and juniper give way to toffee, cinnamon and lavender before a long vanilla, tonka and amber drydown. Warm and syrupy, it is the heavier sibling of Stronger With You.

fragrances.name: Eros Flame
fragrances.description: Opens with a bittersweet burst of mandarin, chinotto and pepper, then warms through rose and geranium into a vanilla-tonka base with woods and patchouli. Spicier and more citrus-driven than the original Eros, with a cosy evening feel.

fragrances.name: Sauvage Parfum
fragrances.description: A smoother, woodier Sauvage: mandarin and bergamot settle quickly into creamy sandalwood and tonka bean. Less sharp than the original, with a rounder, more mature finish.
pros: Creamier and less harsh than the original
Easy to wear day or night
cons: Close to the other Sauvage versions

fragrances.name: Acqua di Giò Profondo
fragrances.description: A deeper, saltier variation on Acqua di Giò: marine notes and green mandarin over rosemary, lavender and cypress, drying down to a mineral amber and musk. Cool and aquatic, with more depth than the original.
pros: Clean marine freshness that suits heat
cons: Close to many other blue scents

fragrances.name: Luna Rossa Ocean
fragrances.description: Bergamot and pink pepper over iris, lavender and a soft suede, finishing on vetiver and patchouli. Clean and slightly powdery, it sits between a fresh blue fragrance and Prada's familiar iris style.
pros: Iris-suede touch sets it apart from typical blues

fragrances.name: Le Male Elixir
fragrances.description: A dense, resinous take on the Le Male lavender theme: lavender and mint quickly sink into vanilla, benzoin, honey, tonka and tobacco. Very sweet and ambery, it is built for cold weather and evenings.
pros: Strong presence from a few sprays

fragrances.name: The Most Wanted Parfum
fragrances.description: A simple structure of spicy ginger, smooth woods and bourbon vanilla. Sweet and toasty rather than fresh, it projects strongly and suits nights out in cooler months.
cons: Similar to other sweet designer flankers

fragrances.name: Phantom
fragrances.description: Lemon and lavender over a creamy vanilla, with a light vetiver-patchouli base. Bright, sweet and clearly aimed at a younger audience.
pros: Sweet lavender profile is easy to wear

fragrances.name: Bad Boy
fragrances.description: Opens with white and black pepper lifted by bergamot, moving into sage and cedar before a cocoa and tonka base. Spicy and lightly sweet, with a darker edge than many mainstream releases.

fragrances.name: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense
fragrances.description: A sweeter, darker take on Born in Roma in which vanilla leads from the start, joined by lavender over a vetiver base. Smooth and gourmand-leaning, it suits evenings and cooler weather.

fragrances.name: Stronger With You
fragrances.description: Cardamom, pink pepper and violet leaf open onto sage, then settle into a soft base of vanilla and candied chestnut. Sweet, warm and approachable, it is a casual cold-weather scent rather than a formal one.
cons: Projection drops after the first hours
Can read too sweet for some

fragrances.name: MYSLF
fragrances.description: Built around a generous dose of orange blossom, framed by bergamot at the top and a clean ambery-woody base. Floral for a men's designer release, it reads modern, soft and easy to wear.
pros: Floral twist on the fresh men's category
cons: Orange blossom may feel too floral for some

fragrances.name: K by Dolce&Gabbana
fragrances.description: Blood orange, Sicilian lemon and juniper open onto an aromatic heart of clary sage, lavender, geranium and pimento, over a dry base of vetiver, cedar and patchouli. Fresh and easygoing, it suits daytime wear in most seasons.

fragrances.name: Gentleman Réserve Privée
fragrances.description: Pairs a boozy whisky and bergamot opening with a buttery, powdery iris. Warm and refined, with a dressier character than most designer releases.
cons: Powdery iris is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Hero
fragrances.description: A clean, dry woody scent that layers three cedars under a brief bergamot and juniper opening, with a touch of black pepper. Straightforward and fresh, it suits daytime and office wear.

fragrances.name: Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Green mandarin and a salty marine accord lead into clary sage, lavender and geranium, drying down to patchouli and vetiver with a mineral edge. It keeps the aquatic idea of the original but reads darker, more herbal and more grown-up.
pros: Deeper take on a familiar aquatic
Easy in the office and in heat
cons: Close enough to other blue scents to seem safe

fragrances.name: Stronger With You Absolutely
fragrances.description: A boozy rum accord with bergamot and elemi opens onto lavender and fruity davana, settling into chestnut, vanilla, cedar and patchouli. Dense, sweet and resinous, it is a cold-weather evening scent.

fragrances.name: 1 Million Parfum
fragrances.description: Salt, solar notes and monoi oil sit around a creamy tuberose, with pine and cashmeran over a base of leather, labdanum and ambergris. A sunny, suntan-lotion leather that is quite unlike the cinnamon-sweet 1 Million original.
pros: Stands apart within the 1 Million line
cons: Tuberose and sunscreen feel divides opinion

fragrances.name: Invictus Victory Elixir
fragrances.description: Lavender, cardamom and black pepper open onto incense and patchouli, then settle into vanilla and tonka bean. Dense, spicy-sweet and resinous, it projects hard and suits cold nights.
cons: Close to other sweet designer elixirs

fragrances.name: Invictus Aqua
fragrances.description: Yuzu, grapefruit and pink pepper over a sea-water accord with violet leaf, resting on ambergris, amberwood and guaiac wood. A brighter, more watery and less sweet cousin of Invictus.
cons: Close to many other sporty aquatics

fragrances.name: Invictus Platinum
fragrances.description: Absinthe and grapefruit open onto cool mint and lavender, drying down to cypress and patchouli. Fresher and more aromatic than the sweet Invictus flankers, with a bright, just-showered feel.
pros: Good for warm days and sport

fragrances.name: Invictus Victory
fragrances.description: Lemon and pink pepper open onto lavender and frankincense, settling into vanilla, amber and tonka bean. A smooth, sweet amber-vanilla that sits far from the fresh-marine Invictus original.

fragrances.name: Phantom Parfum
fragrances.description: Bergamot, lemon, rhubarb and cardamom lead into a lavender heart with geranium, patchouli and cedar, drying down to vanilla, tolu balsam and vetiver. A warmer, woodier take on the Phantom lavender-vanilla idea.

fragrances.name: Wanted by Night
fragrances.description: Cinnamon, mandarin and lemon over a fruity heart of red cedar, incense and cumin, sinking into tobacco, vanilla, leather and benzoin. Spicy-sweet and warm, it is a popular cold-weather evening scent at a designer price.

fragrances.name: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense
fragrances.description: Cardamom opens onto a sticky toffee accord over an amber-wood base. Sweet, spicy and dense, it is a compact gourmand built for cold nights.
cons: Very sweet and a little synthetic to some

fragrances.name: Wanted
fragrances.description: Lemon, ginger, lavender and mint open onto apple, cardamom, juniper and geranium over tonka bean, amberwood and vetiver. A bright, spicy-citrus woody that sits between fresh and warm and is easy to wear in most settings.

fragrances.name: Eros Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Mint, lemon, mandarin and candied apple open onto geranium, clary sage and ambroxan, over cedar, sandalwood, patchouli, a touch of leather and vanilla. Woodier and a little darker than the Eros EDT, with the same fresh-sweet signature.
pros: Recognisable Eros DNA with more depth

fragrances.name: Eros Energy
fragrances.description: A burst of lemon, lime, grapefruit, blood orange, bergamot and mandarin moves into pink pepper, blackcurrant and a light amber, over musk, oakmoss and patchouli. Bright and zesty, it is the citrus-woody daytime member of the Eros line.
pros: Less sweet than other Eros versions
cons: Less distinctive than the rest of the line

fragrances.name: L'Homme Intense
fragrances.description: Iris leads into amber and patchouli, with a base of tonka bean, leather and sandalwood. It keeps the powdery iris feel of L'Homme but runs warmer, deeper and more sensual.
cons: Powdery style is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Luna Rossa
fragrances.description: Lavender and bitter orange with spearmint and clary sage, resting on ambroxan and ambrette. A clean, sharp lavender scent that feels crisp and restrained.

fragrances.name: Luna Rossa Sport
fragrances.description: Juniper berries and ginger over lavender, finishing in tonka bean and vanilla. A sweet, spicy-aromatic blend that is warmer and more gourmand than the name suggests.
cons: Less sporty than the name implies

fragrances.name: L'Homme L'Eau
fragrances.description: Neroli and ginger lead into iris and a soft amber, over powdery notes, sandalwood and cedar. A lighter, airier cut of L'Homme that keeps the clean iris and adds a fresh neroli lift.

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled Parfum
fragrances.description: Mandarin and frankincense open onto a heart of fig tree and orris, with cedarwood and a leathery base. It departs from the apple-cinnamon Bottled EDT, reading as a smooth woody iris with a soft leather edge.

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled Elixir
fragrances.description: Frankincense and cardamom over patchouli and vetiver, settling onto labdanum and cedar. A dry, resinous amber-woody scent with a smoky incense thread, much less sweet than many recent elixirs.

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Apple, bergamot and black pepper open onto cinnamon, cardamom and chestnut, drying down to vetiver and musk. It follows the familiar Bottled apple-spice blueprint with a spicier, slightly deeper finish.
pros: Familiar Bottled DNA with more spice

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled Night
fragrances.description: Birch leaf and lavender warmed by cardamom, with a powdery violet heart and a smooth base of pale wood and musk. Relaxed and soft-spoken, it stays close to the skin rather than filling a room.

fragrances.name: Hugo Man
fragrances.description: A sharp green-apple and mint opening with lavender and sage, drying down to pine needles, oakmoss and patchouli. Brisk and outdoorsy, with an unmistakably 1990s green-aromatic character.

fragrances.name: Legend Spirit
fragrances.description: A brighter, cleaner take on the Legend fougere: grapefruit and pink pepper up top, a watery lavender and cardamom heart, and a soft base of white musk and cashmere wood. Airy and laundry-fresh rather than sweet.

fragrances.name: Gentleman Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Lavender and a peppery iris layered over a dark black-vanilla base, giving a powdery, refined sweetness. Polished and grown-up, it suits smart evenings and cooler days.
cons: Powdery iris is not to every taste

fragrances.name: Gentleman Society
fragrances.description: Herbal sage and a green, slightly honeyed narcissus sit over smooth vetiver and creamy vanilla. The result is a soft, modern woody-floral with gentle sweetness.
pros: Less loud than typical sweet designers

fragrances.name: Pi
fragrances.description: Herbal tarragon, basil and rosemary open onto a creamy base of vanilla, tonka, almond and benzoin. Warm and dessert-like, it is a long-standing cold-weather staple from the late 1990s.

fragrances.name: Mr. Burberry
fragrances.description: Grapefruit and tarragon lead into nutmeg and birch leaf over a dry, faintly smoky base of cedar, guaiac wood and vetiver. Crisp and restrained, it leans traditional rather than sweet.
cons: Understated to the point of forgettable

fragrances.name: Brit for Him
fragrances.description: Ginger, cardamom and green mandarin lead into nutmeg and cedar, settling on a soft tonka and grey musk base. Warm, gently spicy and quiet, it is an easy cooler-weather scent.

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès Parfum
fragrances.description: Orange and grapefruit meet a pronounced flinty, mineral accord, anchored by resinous benzoin, oakmoss and dry woods, with a green shiso nuance at the start. Denser and darker than the eau de toilette, with a quiet but tenacious trail.
pros: Deeper, richer take on the original Terre d'Hermès
cons: Dry, austere style is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès Eau Givrée
fragrances.description: Sharp citron and tingling Timut pepper with a gin-like juniper-berry freshness over a dry woody backdrop. Icy and bright, it reads as a cooler, more citrus-forward variation on Terre d'Hermès.
pros: Very crisp, cooling citrus and pepper

fragrances.name: Voyage d'Hermès
fragrances.description: A spare, airy blend of lemon and cardamom over a transparent heart of tea and green florals, settling into clean white woods and musk. Understated and cerebral, it smells more of fresh linen than of anywhere exotic.

fragrances.name: L'Homme Idéal
fragrances.description: Citrus, rosemary and orange blossom give way to an amaretto-like almond and tonka heart, then a soft leather, vetiver and vanilla drydown. Sweet, smooth and approachable, with a nutty character that sets it apart from typical fresh designers.
cons: Performance only average for the eau de toilette

fragrances.name: Habit Rouge
fragrances.description: Bright citrus and rosewood over a warm, powdery heart of carnation and cinnamon, drying to vanilla, benzoin, amber and a hint of leather. A refined, old-school men's oriental with a dandyish, powdery elegance.
cons: Powdery style reads dated to some
